name: zarchive_list_find_payload_by_value
description: zArchiveList::FindPayloadByValue scans the circular archive list from head and returns the first payload whose leading 32-bit value matches the requested value, or null when absent.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage checks a middle payload hit and the null result after that payload is removed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x48cc20 validate the null-list and empty-list returns, circular head-first traversal, comparison of *(uint32_t*)payload against EDX, payload pointer return on match, and wraparound null return.
The native smoke stores value-bearing payload records, verifies lookup of the middle value returns that payload pointer, removes it, and verifies the same value is no longer found.
